trans-unit.source: Profile
Your public, bookable coaching page
A coaching page people
book on sight.
Your profile is the page you send people to. It shows who you are, what you run, and lets someone book without a single back and forth message.
A public page at your own handle
Show your sessions, products and prices
Let people book without messaging you first
One link for your bio, your DMs, anywhere
Built for a phone, where your clients already are
Show ratings from the clients you've worked with
One link does the explaining
Stop retyping your offer in DMs. Send the link and let the page answer.
Booked while you sleep
People find a slot and take it instead of waiting for you to reply.
It looks like you
Your name, your photo, your sessions. Not a listing in someone's directory.
Do I need my own website?
No. Your profile is the page. If you already have a site, link to it from there.
Can people book without an account?
They create a free account as they book, so the session lives in one place for both of you.
Is my profile public?
Yes, that is the point. It is a page you can share anywhere, and you decide what is listed on it.
Coach profile: a free bookable page | MotionHive
Get a free public coaching page where clients see your sessions and products and book without messaging you first. Your link, your offer, no subscription.
Sessions
Class & 1:1 scheduling with bookings
Scheduling that
fills itself.
Run classes, groups and one to ones without the calendar tetris. You set what you run and when, and people take the spot themselves.
One off and recurring sessions
Class capacity with a waitlist that auto promotes
One to one bookings on your terms
At your own venues or online, with the meeting link attached
Cancellation windows you decide
Reminders so people actually turn up
Fewer no shows
Automatic reminders and a clear cancellation window do the nagging for you.
Set the week once
Recurring sessions mean you build it once, not every Sunday night.
Terms as booked
The price and cutoff that applied when they booked is what holds. No arguments later.
Can I run both classes and one to ones?
Yes. Give group sessions a capacity and keep one to ones at a single spot.
What happens when a class is full?
People join a waitlist, and the first in line is promoted automatically when someone cancels.
Does it handle online sessions?
Yes. Attach the meeting link to the session and it goes out with the booking.
Free class and PT scheduling for coaches | MotionHive
Free scheduling for coaches: recurring classes, capacity and waitlists, one to one bookings, your own venues, reminders and cancellation windows. No subscription.
Programs
Build training plans clients follow
Training plans your clients
stick to.
Build a program once and give every client a plan they can open on their own, without you narrating it down a chat thread.
Build weeks and days, not spreadsheets
Reuse one program across many clients
Set sets, reps, load and rest per exercise
Swap an exercise without rebuilding the plan
Clients tick off work as they do it
See who is actually training
Build once, reuse forever
Your best program becomes a template instead of a one off you rewrite each time.
No more "what was Tuesday?"
The plan lives where they train, not three weeks up a chat thread.
You can see the truth
Logged work tells you who needs a nudge before they quietly drift off.
Can I reuse a program for more than one client?
Yes. Build it once, assign it to whoever it suits, and adjust it per person from there.
Can clients see it on their phone?
Yes. They open their week and work through it, ticking sets as they go.
What if someone needs a different exercise?
Swap it on their copy. The original program stays intact for everyone else.
Free workout program builder for coaches | MotionHive
Build training programs clients actually follow: reusable plans, sets and reps, exercise swaps and logged work. Free, with unlimited clients.
Exercises
Your own exercise library with clips
Your movements, your cues,
one library.
Stop re explaining the same lift every week. Give every exercise one home, with your clip and the cues you actually say attached to it.
Your own library, not a stock list
Attach a clip so form is not a guess
Write the cues you actually use
Tag by muscle, kit and movement pattern
Drop exercises straight into programs
Fork a movement and make it yours
Explain it once
Your clip and cues travel with the exercise into every program you build.
Findable in seconds
Tags mean you are not scrolling a camera roll in the middle of a session.
It sounds like you
Your words on the movement, not a generic description someone else wrote.
Do I have to film everything myself?
No. Start with what you have and add clips over time. The library works either way.
Can I change a shared exercise?
Fork it. You get your own copy to edit without touching the original.
Can clients see the clips?
Yes. The clip and cues show up right where the exercise sits in their plan.
Build your own exercise library with clips | MotionHive
Give every exercise one home: your clips, your cues, your tags, dropped straight into programs. Free for coaches, unlimited clients.
Progress
Log every workout, see your progress
See yourself getting
stronger.
Log each workout as you go, then look back and see how far you have come. Your sets, your reps and your personal bests, all in one place.
Log sets, reps and weight as you train
Pick up an unfinished workout where you left off
See your history for every exercise
Track personal bests and one rep maxes
Follow the plan your coach assigned
Built for your phone, right at the rack
Proof you are improving
The numbers do not lie. Watch your weights climb week over week.
Never lose your place
Start a workout, get interrupted, and pick it back up later without missing a set.
Your whole history, one tap away
Every session you have logged is there when you want to compare.
Do I need a coach to use it?
No. Log your own workouts, or follow a plan your coach assigned. Both work.
Can I see my old workouts?
Yes. Your full history stays with you, exercise by exercise.
Does it track personal bests?
Yes, including your estimated one rep max as your numbers go up.
Track your workouts and progress, free | MotionHive
Log every set, rep and weight, resume unfinished workouts, and watch your progress and personal bests over time. Free, in one place.
Payments
Get paid without chasing bank transfers
Get paid without becoming a
debt collector.
One place for what people owe you. Charge for sessions, packages or a membership, and stop chasing bank transfers on a Sunday night.
Take card payments for sessions and packages
Recurring memberships that renew themselves
Send an invoice in a couple of clicks
See who has paid and who has not
Refunds inside the rules you set
Create products once and show them on your page
No more month end chasing
Reminders go out on their own, so you stay the coach instead of the collector.
Memberships that just run
Recurring plans renew without you raising an invoice every month.
One place for what you're owed
Invoices, memberships and one-off charges live together, so you always know who owes what.
What can I charge for?
Sessions, packages, one-off products and recurring memberships. You create them once and they can show on your page.
When do I get paid?
Payouts follow your payment processor schedule and land straight in your account.
Can I charge in my own currency?
Yes. Your prices and payouts follow the currency your account settles in.
Payments for coaches: invoices, subscriptions, products | MotionHive
Charge for sessions and packages, run recurring memberships, create products for your page and send invoices, all in one place. No subscription to manage clients.
Messaging
Message clients 1:1, where the training lives
A message at the right
moment.
The small human touches are what keep people coming back. Keep them in the same place as the training, instead of an app where the thread disappears.
Message each client one to one
Real-time, so a reply lands right away
One thread per client, not scattered across apps
A quick word between sessions when it matters
Nothing buried under family photos
For as many clients as you coach
Feels like a normal chat
Real-time messages, so a check-in lands right away instead of sitting in an inbox.
People feel seen
A quick note about last week's cranky knee is what keeps clients around.
One inbox
Stop losing threads across three apps and a comment section.
Does this replace WhatsApp?
For coaching, yes. Keeping the conversation next to the training is the whole point.
Is it one to one only?
For now, yes. One to one keeps coaching personal; group threads are on the roadmap.
Is there a client limit?
No. Message as many people as you coach.
Message clients where the training lives | MotionHive
Message your clients one to one, in real time, in the same place as their training. Free, with no client limit.
Community
Groups that keep clients coming back
A hive, not a
spreadsheet.
People stay for the room, not only the program. Groups give your clients somewhere to belong instead of being a list of names in a file.
Create groups around what you run
Invite people with a link
Post updates, with comments and reactions
Approve who joins, if you want to
Sessions and posts in the same place
Works at five clients and at fifty
Retention comes from the room
People stick around for the others, not only for you.
Say it once
One update reaches the group instead of ten separate messages.
It scales with you
The same space works for a handful of regulars and for a full community.
Can I control who joins?
Yes. Use an open link, or review each request before you let someone in.
Is a group the same as a class?
No. The group is the room. Sessions are what you run inside it.
Can members talk to each other?
Yes, and that is the point. The room is what keeps people coming back.
Groups and community for coaches, free | MotionHive
Give clients a room to belong to: groups, invite links, updates and join approvals. Free for coaches, with no client limit.

Our story
Built for coaches, and the people who show up.
MotionHive exists because running your coaching shouldn't take five different apps.
The problem
Why we built it.
If you coach, you know how it goes. WhatsApp for scheduling, a spreadsheet for who paid, Instagram for updates, and half your clients still miss the session.
There's no single place where you and the people you train can just stay in sync. No noise, no jumping between apps, no chasing bank transfers at the end of the month.
That's what MotionHive is. One home for independent coaches, whether you run a yoga class, a strength gym, a running club, or 1:1 sessions online.
It's early, and we build it in the open. No inflated numbers, no empty promises. Just the tool coaches should have had a long time ago.
What drives us
What we believe.
A few principles that shape everything we build.
Community first.
The best motivation isn't an app notification. It's the people you show up with.
Keep it simple.
If it takes more than a minute to figure out, we built it wrong.
Not just fitness.
Yoga, hiking, martial arts, dance. If people come together to move, it belongs here.
Build in the open.
No fake metrics. We share what's ready, what's next, and what we're learning along the way.

Cookie Policy.
Last updated: .

This Cookie Policy explains how HIVECRAFT S.R.L., doing business as MotionHive ("Company," "we," "us," and "our"), uses cookies and similar technologies to recognise you when you visit our website at https://motionhive.fit and its subdomains, including app.motionhive.fit (the "Website"). It explains what these technologies are and why we use them, as well as your rights to control our use of them.

In some cases we may use cookies and similar technologies to collect personal information, or information that becomes personal information if we combine it with other information. For more on how we handle personal data, see our Privacy Policy.
What are cookies?

Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. We also use similar technologies, such as browser local storage, which store small amounts of data in your browser. Cookies are widely used by website owners in order to make their websites work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.

Cookies set by the website owner (in this case, HIVECRAFT S.R.L.) are called "first-party cookies." Cookies set by parties other than the website owner are called "third-party cookies." Third-party cookies enable third-party features or functionality to be provided on or through the website (for example, analytics or interactive content). The parties that set these third-party cookies can recognise your device both when it visits the website in question and when it visits certain other websites.
Why do we use cookies?

We use cookies and similar technologies primarily for reasons that are essential to operating our Website and keeping you signed in, and to remember your preferences. We currently do not use cookies for advertising, and we keep our use of non-essential technologies to a minimum. The specific technologies we use, and the purposes they perform, are described below.
The cookies and technologies we use
Strictly necessary

These technologies are required for the Website and app to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually set in response to actions you take, such as signing in or setting your privacy preferences. They are mainly used to authenticate you and keep your session secure on app.motionhive.fit.
Functional

These technologies enable the Website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation, such as remembering your theme, language, and tool inputs. They are not strictly necessary, but they improve your experience.

How can I control cookies?

You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject non-essential cookies and similar technologies. Because the technologies we currently use are either strictly necessary or functional (for example, remembering your theme), you can control them mainly through your browser settings and, where a cookie preference centre or consent banner is made available on the Website, through that tool. Strictly necessary technologies cannot be rejected, as they are essential to provide you with the Services.

If you choose to reject or clear functional storage, you may still use our Website, although some preferences (such as your theme or saved tool inputs) may not be remembered, and some functionality may be restricted.
How can I control cookies in my browser?

The way you refuse or clear cookies and local storage varies from browser to browser. You should visit your browser's help menu for more information. The following links explain how to manage cookies in the most popular browsers:
What about other tracking technologies, like web beacons?

Cookies are not the only way to recognise or track visitors to a website. We may use other, similar technologies from time to time, like web beacons (sometimes called "tracking pixels" or "clear gifs"). These are tiny graphics files that contain a unique identifier that enables us to recognise when someone has visited our Website or opened an email that includes them — for example, to understand traffic patterns or measure the success of an email campaign. In many instances, these technologies rely on cookies to function properly, so declining cookies will impair their functioning.
Do you serve targeted advertising?

No. We do not currently serve third-party or targeted advertising on the Website, and we do not allow third parties to place advertising cookies through it. If this changes in the future, we will update this Cookie Policy and, where required, obtain your consent before placing any advertising or tracking cookies.
How often will you update this Cookie Policy?

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please therefore revisit this Cookie Policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies and related technologies. The date at the top of this Cookie Policy indicates when it was last updated.
Where can I get further information?
If you have any questions about our use of cookies or other technologies, please contact us:

This Privacy Notice for HIVECRAFT S.R.L. (doing business as MotionHive) ("we," "us," or "our"), describes how and why we might access, collect, store, use, and/or share ("process") your personal information when you use our services ("Services"), including when you:
Visit our website at motionhive.fit or any website of ours that links to this Privacy Notice
Download and use our mobile application (MotionHive), or any other application of ours that links to this Privacy Notice
Engage with us in other related ways, including any marketing or events

Questions or concerns? Reading this Privacy Notice will help you understand your privacy rights and choices. We are responsible for making decisions about how your personal information is processed. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our Services. If you still have any questions or concerns, please contact us at privacy@motionhive.fit.
Summary of key points
This summary provides key points from our Privacy Notice, but you can find out more details about any of these topics by using the table of contents below to find the section you are looking for.

What personal information do we process? When you visit, use, or navigate our Services, we may process personal information depending on how you interact with us and the Services, the choices you make, and the products and features you use.

Do we process any sensitive personal information? Some of the information may be considered "special" or "sensitive" in certain jurisdictions. We may process sensitive personal information when necessary with your consent or as otherwise permitted by applicable law.
Do we collect any information from third parties? We do not collect any information from third parties.

How do we process your information? We process your information to provide, improve, and administer our Services, communicate with you, for security and fraud prevention, and to comply with law. We may also process your information for other purposes with your consent. We process your information only when we have a valid legal reason to do so.
In what situations and with which types of parties do we share personal information? We may share information in specific situations and with specific categories of third parties.

How do we keep your information safe? We have adequate organizational and technical processes and procedures in place to protect your personal information. However, no electronic transmission over the internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure, so we cannot promise or guarantee that hackers, cybercriminals, or other unauthorized third parties will not be able to defeat our security and improperly collect, access, steal, or modify your information.
What are your rights? Depending on where you are located geographically, the applicable privacy law may mean you have certain rights regarding your personal information.
How do you exercise your rights? The easiest way to exercise your rights is by contacting us. We will consider and act upon any request in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

This information does not reveal your specific identity (like your name or contact information) but may include device and usage information, such as your IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, referring URLs, device name, country, location, information about how and when you use our Services, and other technical information. This information is primarily needed to maintain the security and operation of our Services, and for our internal analytics and reporting purposes.
Like many businesses, we also collect information through cookies and similar technologies. You can find out more about this in our Cookie Notice: https://www.motionhive.fit/cookie-policy.
The information we collect includes:

Log and usage data. Service-related, diagnostic, usage, and performance information our servers automatically collect when you access or use our Services and which we record in log files. This may include your IP address, device information, browser type and settings, and information about your activity in the Services (such as date/time stamps, pages and files viewed, searches, and other actions you take), and device event information (such as system activity and error reports).

Device data. Information about your computer, phone, tablet, or other device you use to access the Services, such as IP address, device and application identification numbers, browser type, hardware model, internet service provider and/or mobile carrier, operating system, and system configuration information.

Location data. Information about your device's location, which can be either precise or imprecise. You can opt out of allowing us to collect this information either by refusing access or by disabling your Location setting on your device.
Google API. Our use of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

We process your personal information for a variety of reasons, depending on how you interact with our Services, including:
To facilitate account creation and authentication and otherwise manage user accounts.
To deliver and facilitate delivery of services to the user.
To respond to user inquiries/offer support to users.
To send administrative information to you about our products and services, changes to our terms and policies, and other similar information.
To fulfill and manage your orders, payments, returns, and exchanges made through the Services.
To enable user-to-user communications.

3. What legal bases do we rely on to process your information?

In short:We only process your personal information when we believe it is necessary and we have a valid legal reason (i.e., legal basis) to do so under applicable law, like with your consent, to comply with laws, to provide you with services to enter into or fulfill our contractual obligations, to protect your rights, or to fulfill our legitimate business interests.

What TDEE means for active people

Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) is the calories your body burns in a day. If you train often, that number swings a lot depending on how hard you go. The Mifflin-St Jeor equation gives you a solid starting point. After two weeks, adjust your target by 100 to 200 kcal based on how your weight actually moves.
Why macros matter for recovery

Hitting your calorie target comes first. Your macro split then decides whether those calories rebuild muscle, refill glycogen, or support your hormones. A 40/30/30 split of carbs, protein and fat works well for most group fitness athletes. Push protein higher, up to 35 to 40%, if your main goal is body recomposition.

How accurate is this calorie calculator?

This calculator uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, the most accurate formula for estimating Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) for most people. Its margin of error is roughly ±10%. For a more precise number, book a DEXA scan or a clinical resting metabolic rate test.
Should I eat more on HIIT days?

Yes. High-intensity training burns noticeably more calories, so on hard days an extra 200 to 400 calories helps. Eat complex carbs before your session and protein within 30 minutes of finishing to support performance and recovery.
What is a safe calorie deficit for weight loss?

A deficit of 300 to 500 calories a day is safe and sustainable for most people, which is roughly 0.3 to 0.5 kg (about 0.5 to 1 lb) of fat loss a week. Going beyond 1,000 calories a day risks muscle loss, nutrient gaps and a slower metabolism that stalls progress.
